issues.description: Independent test verification failed: pytest tests/test_client.py reports tests_passed: false after 6.27s execution. Runtime parity check also failed with exit code 1. While the evidence bundle shows quality_gates.all_gates_passed: true (contradictory), the instruction set mandates treating independent_tests as the authoritative test signal. The test output capture appears degraded (raw_output shows placeholder text rather than actual pytest output), but the verdict is clear: tests failed.
issues.requirement: All acceptance criteria depend on passing tests to verify runtime correctness. Independent verification must pass before approval.
issues.suggestion: Re-run pytest tests/test_client.py -v --tb=short and pytest tests/ -x -m 'not integration' locally to identify the specific failure. Investigate the discrepancy between quality_gates (passing) and independent_tests (failing). The 6.27s execution time suggests tests ran but encountered failures. Check for: async test issues, mock setup problems, assertion failures in publish_episode tests, or pre-existing test failures in other files affecting the suite.

rationale: Cannot approve despite all 6 ACs being structurally verified by the orchestrator's requirements checker. The authoritative independent test signal (independent_tests.tests_passed: false, runtime_parity exit code 1) indicates runtime failures that must be investigated and resolved. The evidence bundle contains contradictory signals (quality_gates passing vs independent_tests failing), but my instructions mandate treating independent_tests as authoritative. The degraded test output capture prevents root cause analysis, requiring the Player to re-run tests with full output to diagnose the failure.
